parties.respondent: State through the Inspector of Police & Anr.

summary: Cross FIRs between two advocates over altercation at Kodaikanal Lake; both cases stem from same incident on 18.12.2017; second respondent tenders unconditional apology; first appellant threatens suicide before Court if quashing occurs; conduct condemned as contemptuous; Court emphasizes amicable resolution between legal professionals; both FIRs quashed in interest of justice and decorum of legal profession.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.294(b), s.323, s.506(1)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; both FIRs quashed; criminal proceedings set aside; quietus granted to dispute between legal fraternity members.
